description: A frame that does not move: one immobile tower per side parked in opposite corners, camera on empty ground in the middle of the map. Two consecutive glshots are pixel-identical, which is what makes it the oracle for any A/B whose subject is the terrain, the features or the zoom — nothing animates, so every differing pixel is the change under test. Built 2026-09-09 for the 4K zoom-out budget fix.
